title: Design System: VINII Guest Storefront
notes: Source is Flutter (canvas rendering), not HTML/CSS. Tokens live in vinii_partner/lib/presentation/theme/guest_theme.dart and guest/look/*.dart. The html/css in components is an illustrative web translation of the Flutter widgets for the panel, not shipped code. Derived values (key-light, lit surface, gold hairline, tonal ramps) are computed from the default gold accent, not read as constants. Staff app (ViniiTokens, staff_theme.dart) is a separate Operate-mode system and is not documented here.

display.purpose: Screen titles, dish names, stamps. w800, -0.8 tracking (0 for serif or script).

hero-script.purpose: Artisan welcome headline only; written on once; one weight.

price.purpose: All money; w800 with tabular figures.

shadows.name: lift-1-dark
shadows.purpose: Raised cards on dark pages. Offset, blur and alpha scale with level.

shadows.name: stage-key-light
shadows.value: radial from (-0.55,-0.7), radius 0.85 x longest side, key light @ 40% dark / 34% light fading to 0

shadows.name: stage-vignette
shadows.value: radial, 0 at 55% to black @55% dark / #3A2410 @10% light

motion.name: press-scale
motion.purpose: Pressable down state; hover growth only for pointers.

motion.name: pulse
motion.purpose: Budget ring beat when a price lands.

motion.name: stage-drift
motion.purpose: Out-of-focus light; stops under reduced motion.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Loops stop, travel becomes instant, state change remains.

breakpoints.name: wide
breakpoints.purpose: Two-pane layout: scene and dish left, ordering column (460px max) right with live order.

breakpoints.name: categories-wide-grid
breakpoints.purpose: Max width of tile grid on wide screens.

breakpoints.name: categories-wide-wheel
breakpoints.purpose: Max width of wheel on wide screens.

components.name: Primary Button (Bistro pill)
components.description: Accent-filled main action; pill on Bistro, 14 radius on Artisan. Flutter: GuestButton(style: primary). Pseudo-snippet: Material(shape: p.buttonShape(), color: p.accent){InkWell{SizedBox(height: 56){Text(label, p.body(16, w700, p.onAccent))}}}; press scales to 0.97.

components.name: Add Button (success)
components.description: Add-to-order on the detail sheet uses success green with white text and the running price.

components.name: Soft Button
components.description: Secondary action: alt surface, ink text.

components.name: Lit Card
components.description: Card on a lit surface with an accent-drawn hairline and a two-layer tinted lift. Flutter: GuestCard with surfaceLit, hairline, lift().

components.name: Item Detail Sheet
components.description: 28px-radius sheet rising over the dish picture, lit (surfaceLit) on a dark page and the page colour on a light one; price in the accent; no drag handle. Flutter: a rounded cap drawn on the picture sliver (guest_item_detail.dart, _sheetRadius) over a SliverFillRemaining sheet.

components.name: Ingredient Chip
components.description: Pill chip with a status dot tinted from the accent or green; accent-tinted fill and hairline.

components.name: Budget Ring
components.description: Circular progress with percent inside; the added dish's price flies into it and it pulses 1 to 1.045. Flutter: ring painted in CustomPaint, CountUp for the figure, Pulse on the trigger.

components.name: Swipe Deck Card
components.description: Front card of three; dragging past 28% of width or a fling above 900px/s commits. ADD green / SKIP red stamp. Flutter: GuestDeck with stacked Transform.
components.css: .ds-deck{background:#0B0B0C;color:#fff;border:1px solid #564A33;border-radius:24px;padding:24px;box-shadow:0 16px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.55),0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.35)}.ds-deck h3{margin:0;font:800 26px Inter;letter-spacing:-.8px}.ds-deck b{font:800 26px Inter;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}

narrative.overview: Every screen is a room with one light in it: a key light from the upper left, taken from the restaurant's accent, falling on a dish that looks already served. Bistro Night is candle-lit (umber blacks, gold that glints). Artisan Day is a morning bakery (flour cream, espresso ink, window light). Fresh Minimal applies the same rules to white and green. The food leads and the interface recedes; from order review onward, the task and the state outrank expression.
keyCharacteristics: One light source, derived from the accent, upper left, everywhere.
Surfaces rise lighter and warmer; never dead flat black or neutral grey cards.
One signature interaction: the three-card swipe deck, where the price flies into the budget ring.
Food is a photo or authored illustration, never an emoji.
CMS colours, faces and button shape carry through the same lighting.
Reduced motion is honoured on every animation.

rules.name: The Light From The Accent Rule
rules.body: Every glow, tint and hairline is computed from the accent through keyLight. No hard-coded brand colour enters the guest runtime.

rules.name: The Rising Surface Rule
rules.body: Surfaces get lighter and warmer as they rise. No flat black cards.

rules.name: The Hairline From The Accent Rule
rules.body: Borders are the neutral border mixed 22% (dark) or 30% (light) toward the key light.

rules.name: The Readable Rule
rules.body: Accent used as text goes through readable(): adjusted only until 4.5:1 against the background.

rules.name: The Night Hero Rule
rules.body: The welcome hero is always set on night so a white headline reads.

rules.name: The Tabular Money Rule
rules.body: Every rupee amount is w800 with tabular figures.

rules.name: The One Weight Script Rule
rules.body: A script face is set at w400 only, in headings only.

rules.name: The Tinted Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadows have an offset and a soft blur, tinted to the room. Never a glow in place of a shadow.

rules.name: The Quiet Stage Rule
rules.body: The stage drifts at about 15 fps, stops under reduced motion, and is a still picture on ordinary pages.

dos: Do derive every tint, glow, hairline and shadow from the accent through keyLight; never hard-code a brand colour.
Do run accent-as-text through readable() (4.5:1 minimum).
Do keep touch targets at 44px or larger; primary buttons 56px.
Do use a photo when the dish has one; otherwise the painted dish art.
Do use the motion vocabulary: 140 / 280 / 460 / 760ms, arrive curve, quicker exits, stagger capped at 270ms.
Do honour reduced motion on every animation, loop and travel.
Do set prices bold with tabular figures.
Do keep one signature interaction and let everything else stay quiet.
Do go two-pane at 900px and above, with the live order in the right column.
donts: Don't use emoji as food or as icons.
Don't add kickers or eyebrow labels over titles.
Don't use glow-only shadows or hard offset shadows.
Don't use rainbow category tiles or dead flat black cards.
Don't float a phone column in empty space on a wide screen.
Don't faux-bold a script face or use one as body text.
Don't make the staff app inherit this look; it is a separate Operate-mode system.
